keywords.def: tasks around the home, such as cleaning, washing and ironing, that have to be done regularly
negative term for the boring and repetitive tasks which are traditionally or stereotypically done by women
way of organising work where different tasks are done by different groups of people
(idiom) stop what you are doing for a short time to rest
work as hard as everyone else doing the same job

sentences.en: Hello, this is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 你好，这里是BBC英语教学的《6分钟英语》。

sentences.en: I'm Neil. And I'm Pippa. When it comes to household chores, jobs like cleaning, washing clothes or looking after the kids, it's often women who do most of the work.
sentences.zh: 我是尼尔。我是皮帕。说到家务活，比如打扫卫生、洗衣服或照顾孩子，通常都是女性在承担大部分工作。

sentences.en: Here, two female listeners of BBC World Service programme People Fixing the World share their experiences.
sentences.zh: 在这里，BBC世界服务部节目《拯救世界的人们》的两名女性听众分享了她们的经历。

sentences.en: Do they sound familiar to you? Listener 1 I do everything.
sentences.zh: 听起来熟悉吗？听众1：我什么都做。

sentences.en: I do all the house chores, I do the food shopping, I do all the cooking, I clean the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 我做所有的家务，我买菜，我做所有的饭，我打扫浴室。

sentences.en: Listener 2 Are the chores done equally between me and my husband?
sentences.zh: 听众2：我和丈夫平摊家务了吗？

sentences.en: No, they're not done equally. I do most of the chores.
sentences.zh: 不，没有平摊。我做了大部分家务。

sentences.en: So, you're a family man, Neil. Do you do your fair share of household chores?
sentences.zh: 所以，尼尔，你是个顾家的男人。你承担了你那份公平的家务吗？

sentences.en: I think so. My wife works part time and I work full time, so when I'm not working, I do things, and when she's not working, she does things.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。我妻子做兼职，我做全职，所以当我不在工作时，我做一些事情，当她不在工作时，她做一些事情。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's similar in my house, so me and my husband try to split things, but it's difficult, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 是的，我家也差不多，我和我丈夫试着分担家务，但这很难，对吧？

sentences.en: It is. Of course, no one enjoys cleaning the toilet or taking out the bins, but there is a serious side to the issue.
sentences.zh: 确实很难。当然，没有人喜欢刷马桶或倒垃圾，但这背后的问题是很严肃的。

sentences.en: Figures from UN Women, an organisation promoting gender equality, suggest that every day women around the world spend three hours more than men on unpaid care and domestic work.
sentences.zh: 联合国妇女署（一个促进性别平等的组织）的数据表明，世界各地的女性每天花在无偿护理和家务劳动上的时间比男性多三个小时。

sentences.en: So, in this episode, we'll be hearing about two projects helping husbands and wives share the housework more fairly.
sentences.zh: 所以，在本期节目中，我们将听到两个帮助丈夫和妻子更公平地分担家务的项目。

sentences.en: And as usual, you'll find a quiz and a worksheet to go with this episode on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样，你可以在我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上找到与本期节目配套的测验和练习单。

sentences.en: But now I have a question for you, Pippa.
sentences.zh: 但现在我有一个问题要问你，皮帕。

sentences.en: According to a survey conducted by Good Housekeeping magazine earlier this year, what is the most hated household chore in Britain?
sentences.zh: 根据《美好家园》杂志今年早些时候进行的一项调查，英国人最讨厌的家务是什么？

sentences.en: Is it: a) deep cleaning the oven, b) scrubbing the toilet, or c) cleaning the windows?
sentences.zh: 是：a）深度清洁烤箱，b）刷马桶，还是 c）擦窗户？

sentences.en: Hmm. I'm going to say deep cleaning the oven because I really hate that job.
sentences.zh: 嗯。我猜是深度清洁烤箱，因为我真的很讨厌那项工作。

sentences.en: I hardly ever do it. I don't like any of those, but we'll find out the answer at the end of the programme.
sentences.zh: 我几乎从不做。我讨厌所有这些，但我们会在节目结束时揭晓答案。

sentences.en: Now, the first project we're going to look at is on the remote Indonesian island of Rote.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们要看的第一个项目在印度尼西亚偏远的罗地岛上。

sentences.en: Here, men traditionally work as rice farmers or fishermen, while women look after the home, the children and older people.
sentences.zh: 在这里，传统上男性是稻农或渔民，而女性则照顾家庭、孩子和老人。

sentences.en: But with few washing machines and no running water, these domestic chores take a long time.
sentences.zh: 但是由于缺乏洗衣机且没有自来水，这些家务活需要很长时间。

sentences.en: The NGO ARUNGI runs a project trying to change attitudes about the role of the island's women.
sentences.zh: NGO ARUNGI 正在运行一个项目，试图改变人们对该岛女性角色的态度。

sentences.en: They work alongside community leaders like Mama Shilpa, who spoke with BBC World Service reporter Ade Mardiyati.
sentences.zh: 他们与社区领袖马玛·席尔帕等人合作，她接受了BBC世界服务部记者阿德·马尔迪亚蒂的采访。

sentences.en: It is expected that the tasks done in the house, like holding the child, feeding the child, washing dishes, cooking, will all be done by the mother.
sentences.zh: 人们期望家里做的事情，比如抱孩子、喂孩子、洗碗、做饭，都应该由母亲来完成。

sentences.en: Shilpa tells me these are all considered women's work.
sentences.zh: 席尔帕告诉我，这些都被认为是女性的工作。

sentences.en: And you might be thinking, "Well, the man is busy in the fields, so it's just a fair division of labour." But Shilpa tells me women also help out in the fields.
sentences.zh: 你可能会想，“嗯，男人在田里很忙，所以这只是劳动的公平分工。”但席尔帕告诉我，女性也去田里帮忙。

sentences.en: On Rote, cleaning, cooking and sweeping are considered women's work – a negative term for boring and repetitive tasks which are traditionally done by women.
sentences.zh: 在罗地岛，清洁、做饭和扫地被认为是女性的工作——这是一个贬义词，指传统上由女性完成的无聊且重复的任务。

sentences.en: Many cultures have a division of labour – a way of organising work where different tasks are done by different groups of people.
sentences.zh: 许多文化都有劳动分工——一种组织工作的方式，不同的任务由不同的人群完成。

sentences.en: But on Rote this means women work even harder, helping out with the farming and fishing too.
sentences.zh: 但在罗地岛，这意味着女性工作甚至更辛苦，还要帮忙干农活和捕鱼。

sentences.en: You might think this only happens in traditional societies, but research suggests that women in wealthy countries also spend much more time on unpaid care work than men.
sentences.zh: 你可能认为这只发生在传统社会中，但研究表明，富裕国家的女性在无偿护理工作上花费的时间也比男性多得多。

sentences.en: One such country is Croatia, where the NGO Status M run their Superdads project.
sentences.zh: 其中一个国家是克罗地亚，非政府组织 Status M 在那里运营他们的“超级老爸”项目。

sentences.en: Project worker Anamarija Sočo leads workshops encouraging dads and sons to take some of the pressure off mums.
sentences.zh: 项目工作人员安娜玛丽亚·索科领导了旨在鼓励爸爸和儿子为妈妈们分担压力的工作坊。

sentences.en: Here, she explains the benefits of this to the BBC World Service.
sentences.zh: 在这里，她向BBC世界服务部解释了这其中的好处。

sentences.en: Anamarija Sočo Mothers have, you know, of course, more space for their careers, or hobbies, or just simply to rest – I mean, just to take a breather.
sentences.zh: 安娜玛丽亚·索科：你知道的，母亲们当然会有更多的空间去发展她们的职业、爱好，或者只是简单地休息——我的意思是，只是喘口气。

sentences.en: Women tend to especially appreciate men who do these kinds of chores.
sentences.zh: 女性往往特别感激做这类家务的男性。

sentences.en: And when they start pulling their weight, then they jokingly say that, "Uh yeah, women tend to nag less."
sentences.zh: 当他们开始尽到自己的责任时，她们就会开玩笑说，“呃，是的，女性往往少唠叨一些。”

sentences.en: Sometimes mums need to take a breather – an informal way of saying stop and rest a while.
sentences.zh: 有时候妈妈们需要喘口气——这是一种非正式的说法，意思是停下来休息一会儿。

sentences.en: Anamarija also thinks women appreciate it when their husbands pull their weight.
sentences.zh: 安娜玛丽亚也认为，当丈夫们尽到自己的责任时，女性会心存感激。

sentences.en: If you pull your weight, you work as hard as everyone else.
sentences.zh: 如果你尽到了自己的责任，你的付出就会和大家一样多。

sentences.en: Both these NGO projects agree about one thing – men doing more to help around the house results in happier homes, even if that means cleaning the toilet now and then.
sentences.zh: 这两个NGO项目都认同一点——男人分担更多家务能带来更幸福的家庭，即使这意味着偶尔刷刷马桶。

sentences.en: And speaking of cleaning the toilet, what was the answer to your quiz question, Neil?
sentences.zh: 说到刷马桶，你测验题的答案是什么，尼尔？

sentences.en: I asked you what chore is the most hated in Britain.
sentences.zh: 我问你英国人最讨厌什么家务。

sentences.en: I thought it was cleaning the oven. Well, I'm afraid that's not the right answer.
sentences.zh: 我以为是清洁烤箱。嗯，恐怕那不是正确的答案。

sentences.en: People hate cleaning the windows even more than scrubbing the oven.
sentences.zh: 人们讨厌擦窗户甚至超过了刷烤箱。

sentences.en: Apparently, 23% of the people who did the survey said cleaning the windows.
sentences.zh: 显然，参与调查的人中有23%的人选择了擦窗户。

sentences.en: OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with chores – household tasks like cleaning, washing and ironing that have to be done regularly.
sentences.zh: 好的。让我们回顾一下我们学过的词汇，从“chores”（家务）开始——必须定期完成的家庭任务，如打扫、洗涤和熨烫。

sentences.en: If you do your fair share of work, you do a reasonable amount.
sentences.zh: 如果你尽了自己那份公平的责任，你就是做了合理的份额。

sentences.en: Women's work is a negative term for the boring and repetitive tasks which are stereotypically done by women.
sentences.zh: “Women's work”（女性的工作）是一个贬义词，指那些刻板印象中由女性完成的无聊且重复的任务。

sentences.en: The division of labour is a way of organising work where different tasks are done by different groups of people.
sentences.zh: “Division of labour”（劳动分工）是一种组织工作的方式，其中不同的任务由不同的人群完成。

sentences.en: The idiom take a breather means to stop what you're doing for a short time and rest.
sentences.zh: 习语“take a breather”的意思是停下手头的事短暂停留并休息。

sentences.en: And finally, if you pull your weight, you work as hard as everyone else doing the same job.
sentences.zh: 最后，如果你“pull your weight”（尽到责任），你的工作就会和做同样工作的其他人一样努力。

sentences.en: Once again, our six minutes are up, but remember, you can find a free transcript including all the vocabulary on our website, at bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 我们的六分钟又到了，但请记住，您可以在我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上找到包含所有词汇的免费文稿。

sentences.en: Goodbye for now. Goodbye!
sentences.zh: 再见。再见！
